facts.text: Rooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Pike Place Market, Puget Sound and the Olympic Mountains.
facts.excerpt: Our downtown Seattle hotel rooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows that showcase views of Pike Place Market, Puget Sound water views, and the Olympic Mountains beyond.

facts.text: Rooms have hardwood floors, midcentury furniture and rainfall showers.
facts.excerpt: Our modern hotel accommodations are adorned with hardwood floors, sleek midcentury furniture and rainfall showers.

facts.text: Rooms have Sferra linens and D.S. & Durga bath toiletries.
facts.excerpt:
- Luxury bedding with Sferra linens
  - D.S. & Durga bath toiletries

facts.text: The Penthouse Suites look out over Pike Place Market and Elliott Bay.
facts.excerpt: Featuring stunning views of Pike Place Market and Elliott Bay, luxurious furnishings, ample space and specialty amenities

facts.text: The Nest is the hotel's rooftop bar, cocktail lounge and terrace, with views of Elliott Bay and the Olympic Mountain Range.
facts.excerpt: rooftop bar, cocktail lounge, and terrace — showcases views of Elliott Bay and the Olympic Mountain Range beyond.

facts.text: The Nest is for ages 21 and over only.
facts.excerpt: Ages 21+ only.

facts.text: Conversation Kitchen & Bar is the hotel's lobby-level all-day restaurant, specializing in seafood, desserts and cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Downstairs, our signature all-day dining concept restaurant, Conversation Kitchen & Bar, specializes in seafood, desserts, cocktails and more.

facts.text: Executive Chef Chris Ingmire leads the kitchen, marrying Pacific Northwest abundance with his experience in kitchens across the country.
facts.excerpt: Executive Chef Chris Ingmire brings a distinct vision that marries Pacific Northwest abundance with his own experience in top kitchens across the country.

facts.text: The Nest rooftop bar is cashless.
facts.excerpt: Please note this bar is cashless. Credit cards, debit cards and other contactless forms of payment are accepted.

facts.text: The Taste of Thompson dinner party menu centers on a tomahawk steak cooked in a Penthouse Suite's kitchen.
facts.excerpt: The centerpiece of the menu is a mouthwatering tomahawk steak, expertly cooked by our highly skilled culinary team in the suite

facts.text: Weekend Booze & Brunch is served on Saturdays and Sundays.
facts.excerpt: On Saturdays and Sundays, guests can choose from an array of brunch favorites, light bites, mimosas and more.

facts.text: The hotel welcomes dogs at no additional charge.
facts.excerpt: We welcome dogs at no additional charge.

facts.text: A daily destination fee applies to each room.
facts.excerpt: A daily destination fee of $29.00 (subject to change) is applied to each room of your stay

facts.text: Valet parking is available at the hotel entrance; the garage has a vehicle height restriction.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is available at the hotel entrance. Our garage has a vehicle height restriction of 6 feet 7 inches

facts.text: The nearest public transit hub is Westlake Station, served by Link light rail, the South Lake Union Streetcar and the Seattle Center Monorail.
facts.excerpt: This hub is served by Line 1 of the Link light rail system, the South Lake Union Streetcar, and the Seattle Center Monorail.
